report: Zu [DATE] progrediente, medial betonte, gering- bis mäßiggradige Gonarthrose mit flächig gemindertem Knorpelbesatz in der medialen Belastungszone, zum Meniskus hin zunehmend. Oberflächliche Chondropathie lateralseitig sowie retropatellar. Bis flächig vollschichtige chondrale Läsion über 21 x 19 mm (ml x cc; 8/17, 6/16) in der Trochlea mit medialer Betonung an den Kondylenwangen bei hier subchondraler Zysten- minimal assozierter Ödembildung. Innenmeniskus gering mukoid im Hinterhorn mit Einriss am freien Rand am Übergang zur Pars intermedia. Chondrale und meniskalen Verkalkungen.Bandstrukturen intakt. Intraossäre Ödembildung an der Innenmeniskushinterhornwurzel mit kleiner Ganglionbildung. Geringer Gelenkerguss, gering flüssigkeitsgefüllte Baker-Zyste. Geringe Reizsynovialitis.

МР находка: Няма МР данни за ставен излив. Гонартрозни промени на дясната колянна става. Изобразяват се масивни остеофитни наслоявания по кондилите на фемура и тибията от латералната страна на колянната става. Изострени интеркондиларни еминенции. Артикулиращият хрущял на фемура и тибията е с нарушена конгруентност до липсващ от латералната страна. МР данни за парциална руптура на предната кръстна връзка с давност (в горна трета връзката е изтънена и се представя с повишен интензитет на сигнала). Нормално представена задна кръстна връзка. 
МР данни за Bucket -handle лезия на латералния менискус. Предният рог на последният не се изобразява на топичното си място, а е изместен над еминенциите , като е налице патогномоничния double PCL sign. Задният рог е руптуриран с увреда  2а степен. Дегенеративни промени в медиалния менискус. Колатерални лигаменти - със запазена цялост. Патела – малки кисти субкортикално по задна стена,  хрущял на пателата - липсва ретинакулуми – б.о. Визуализира се малка многокамерна Бекерова киста на нивото на медиалната глава на м. гастрокнемиус с коронарен р-р 18/11мм. Лимфедем в меките тъкани на коляното. Заключение:  МР данни за тежки гонартрозни промени на дясната колянна става . Хондропатия. МР данни за частична руптура с давност на предна кръстна връзка. Bucket -handle лезия на предния рог на латералния менискус. Парциална увреда на задния рог на латералния менискус – степен 2а.

MRI OF THE KNEE WITHOUT CONTRAST

HISTORY: Left knee pain. Arthralgia of left lower leg

COMPARISON: None.

PROCEDURE: MRI of the left knee with sagittal, coronal and axial images.

INTRAVENOUS CONTRAST: None

FINDINGS:

Large joint effusion. Trace popliteal cyst     

OSSEOUS STRUCTURES (excluding subchondral marrow):
Moderate subchondral edema in the medial tibial plateau without discrete subchondral fracture, in keeping with osseous stress response.No concerning bone marrow replacing lesion.Tiny tricompartmental marginal osteophytes.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT: 
Medial meniscus: Complete radial tear at junction of posterior horn and root with complex tearing extending into body and medial extrusion. A small portion of the extruded meniscus extends into the posterior-medial tibial recess on coronal series 3 image 16. Small subchondral edema at the adjacent femur is likely reactive.
Cartilage: Full-thickness cartilage loss with small subchondral edema/cystic change involves the majority of femur. Full-thickness and high-grade partial thickness cartilage loss involves majority of the tibial plateau.  

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Intact. No discrete tear.
Cartilage: No high-grade cartilage loss. 

ANTERIOR COMPARTMENT:
Patellar cartilage: Focal high-grade cartilage loss with 3 mm full-thickness delaminating chondral fissure and subchondral edema/cystic change in median ridge. Low-grade partial thickness cartilage loss and medial facet.
Trochlear cartilage: Focal low-grade cartilage loss with heterogeneity in trochlear groove.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Quadriceps tendon: Intact.
Patellar tendon: Intact.
Retinaculum: Intact.
Patellofemoral alignment: Mild lateral patellar tilt. Normal TT-TG. No patella alta.
Hoffa's fat pad: Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Intact.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL): Intact.
Posterolateral corner: Intact.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Intact.    
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Intact.    

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
Mild insertional semimembranosus tendinosis.. 

SUBCUTANEOUS SOFT TISSUES: 
Nonspecific subcutaneous edema.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: [REDACTED].
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions. Tricompartmental marginal osteophytes.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Moderate Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complex tearing and maceration of the body of medial meniscus with severe extrusion. Reactive marrow edema along the medial tibial plateau.
Medial compartment cartilage: Moderate cartilage loss throughout the medial compartment.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Inner margin blunting of the body of lateral meniscus.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Moderate cartilage loss with areas of full-thickness fissuring throughout the lateral compartment. No marrow edema,

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full thickness cartilage loss throughout the lateral patellar median ridge and medial patella with subchondral cystic change. High-grade cartilage loss throughout the trochlea.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis. No tendon tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 12 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
Nonspecific prepatellar and scattered subcutaneous edema about the knee. No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle. There is marked MCL bursitis. 

IMPRESSION:
1.	Complex tearing of the medial meniscus body with severe extrusion. 
2.	Tricompartmental osteoarthritis, severe in the patellofemoral compartment. If there is persistent pain, geniculate nerve ablation can be considered. 
3.	There is marked MCL bursitis. 
4.	Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis without tear.

Fortgeschrittene, lateral betonte Pangonarthrose mit lateral flächig in der Belastungszone vollschichtiger Chondropathie beider Gelenkpartner und subkortikalen Ödemarealen. Außenmeniskus extrudiert mit mukoider Auffaserung der Pars intermedia sowie insbesondere des Vorderhorns. Die VH-Wurzel dabei nicht mehr nachvollziebar und aufgefasert im Gelenk liegend. Kein Ganglion bei gering flüssigkeitsgefülltem Recessus (6/27). Teils tiefergehende Chondropathie auch medial mit gering mukoidem Innenmeniskus ohne umschriebene Rissbildung. VKB gering mukoid und MCL mit geringem Reizzustand, ansonsten Bandapparat intakt. Dtl. Femoropatellararthrose, führend an der lateralen retropatellaren Facette sowie medialen Trochlea mit fokal tiefergehender Chondropathie und gering lateralisiert stehender Patella. Geringe Insertionstendinopathie der Patellarsehne am Unterpol. Mäßiger Erguss mit Reizsynovialitis. V.a. freien Gelenkkörper im lateralen Recessus suprapatellaris (9/18) sowie verkalkte Gelenkkörper am dorsomedialen Tibiaplateau (CC 13 mm, 6/10). Baker-Zyste mit CC 4,3 cm.
